entities.name: Olle Häger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olle Häger was a Swedish journalist, television producer, writer and historian. Häger produced, often accompanied by historian Hans Villius, a large number of historical documentaries. In 1986, Häger and Villius were awarded the Stora Journalistpriset.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olle Häger was a Swedish journalist, television producer, writer and historian. Häger produced, often accompanied by historian Hans Villius, a large number of historical documentaries. In 1986, Häger and Villius were awarded the Stora Journalistpriset.
